categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the digital X-ray core components and integrated solutions sector, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of digital X-ray detectors, high-voltage generators, integrated X-ray sources, and X-ray tubes. Its products serve medical imaging, industrial non-destructive testing, and security inspection fields. The business is divided mainly into medical and industrial product lines, including static and dynamic digital detectors, and other core X-ray components.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses proprietary technologies in sensor design and manufacturing, including amorphous silicon, IGZO, CMOS, and flexible substrate sensors. It has advanced capabilities in scintillator materials, packaging processes, readout chips, low-noise electronics, and intelligent X-ray detection. Production methods include precision coating of cesium iodide scintillators, OCA coupling, and advanced assembly techniques for X-ray tubes and high-voltage generators. The company also develops integrated solutions combining hardware, software, and applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global and domestic X-ray imaging equipment manufacturers in medical fields such as general radiography, dental, mammography, radiotherapy, and veterinary imaging, as well as industrial sectors like battery inspection, semiconductor packaging, casting inspection, pipeline weld inspection, and food safety. Major clients include well-known medical device companies and industrial manufacturers worldwide. The company serves over 80 countries and regions, with a strong presence in Asia, America, and Europe.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with headquarters and multiple production and R&D centers in China (Shanghai, Taicang, Haining, Chengdu, Hefei), and overseas subsidiaries and sales/service platforms in the United States, Germany, South Korea, India, Japan, Mexico, Pakistan, Brazil, and South Africa. Its products are sold in over 80 countries and regions worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company is positioned in the midstream of the X-ray imaging equipment supply chain, manufacturing core components such as digital detectors, high-voltage generators, X-ray tubes, and integrated X-ray sources. It maintains close relationships with upstream suppliers of key raw materials like sensors, scintillators, and electronic components, and supplies these core components to downstream X-ray imaging equipment manufacturers who assemble complete systems for end users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company emphasizes continuous innovation in digital X-ray detector technologies, including CMOS, IGZO, flexible substrates, photon counting, and CT detectors. It invests heavily in R&D, focusing on new core components like high-voltage generators, micro-focus X-ray tubes, and integrated solutions. The company also pursues upstream integration of key raw materials and aims to lead in global X-ray technology innovation, including AI-enabled imaging and advanced materials development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of digital X-ray detectors, core X-ray components (high-voltage generators, X-ray tubes, integrated sources), and integrated technical solutions and services. The company mainly uses a B2B direct sales model supplemented by distributors, selling to X-ray imaging equipment manufacturers who incorporate these components into finished products for medical and industrial markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the few global manufacturers mastering all major core technologies of digital X-ray detectors and holds a leading market position domestically and internationally. Competitors include global giants like Varian, Hamamatsu, Dunlee, Spellman, CPI, and others in the X-ray core components industry. The company has broken foreign monopolies in several product lines and is recognized for its competitive product quality, technology, and service.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.83 billion, a slight decrease of 1.74% year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 465 million, down 23.43%. Total assets reached RMB 9.08 billion, growing 20.92% from the previous year. The company maintains a strong R&D investment ratio of 16.94% of revenue and has expanded production capacity and global footprint, indicating a solid growth trajectory despite short-term profit fluctuations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive mastery of core digital X-ray detector technologies and integrated X-ray component solutions, offering high-performance, reliable, and cost-effective products. Its products feature advanced sensor technologies, low radiation dose, high image quality, and innovative materials, enabling superior clinical and industrial imaging performance. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, vertical integration, and global service network provide differentiated value through innovation, quality, and customer-centric solutions.
